items.title: Greg Thomas interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 11, 2014
items.q: Listen to Cannonball Adderley and how he

ctx.x: Yeah. Absolutely. You know one of the things that, particularly when we’ve hired young musicians I realized that I’m going to have to not only just hire and produce an event featuring young musicians, but sometimes I actually need to get into a coaching modality with them in the sense of, “Hey guys, this is entertainment too. This is entertainment. So you need to communicate with your audience. You know, maybe you’re interacting. You tell some jokes or you let them know what song it is, and you give them a…

Yeah. Listen to Cannonball Adderley and how he — and it’s really interesting you say that because I’m guessing that some of these younger musicians that don’t get that may have graduated from jazz schools.
I think so. I think so, yeah.
